summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for an exciting 2026/27 season with just one week until kick-off, having welcomed several new signings and one returning player to strengthen the squad. The Ramblers put in a solid performance in their recent friendly against St Helens, though fell short as their opponents made the most of their chances. With three brand new kits launched and sponsorship opportunities available, there's plenty of positive momentum building as the team prepares for their promotion push.
